reviews.title: Program no longer works properly
reviews.text: I have used this app for years as a realtor, and I sell a large number of condominiums that all share the same address, but are differentiated by their individual unit numbers.  The complex is not a multi-story building but rather individual units.  I used to be able to look up the individual units to prepare for listing appts etc, but the program no longer allows me to do that.  The program sees the entire complex by the common address of 625 Aunt Lucy Lane.  It no longer separated the various units so I am no longer able to gather the info that I need on the individual units.  Please, please fix this problem quickly!!!!  I rely on this app, and this recent change makes the app much less useful to me.   Thank you.
